description.en: DSH web_search provider that queries the DeepSeek Search API and Exa in parallel and returns one merged, URL-de-duplicated result list. Cross-source hits rank first, one failed engine degrades to the other, snippets are clipped to 800 characters, and the DeepSeek search slot is taken over regardless of the settings card.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 搜索 API 与 Exa 并发查询、按 URL 去重合并成单份结果的 DSH 搜索 provider。跨源命中优先，单路失败自动降级，摘要截断到 800 字符，并接管 DeepSeek 搜索槽，设置页切换不会使其失效。
